meaning_en: Very quickly; almost instantly.
meaning_fa: در یک چشم به هم زدن
example_en: The magician made the rabbit disappear in a flash.
examples_extra: She finished it in a flash.
He was gone in a flash.
note_fa: یعنی «در یک چشم به هم زدن».

meaning_en: Extremely quickly; almost immediately.
example_en: The children finished their homework in less than no time.
examples_extra: We'll fix it in less than no time.
She finished in less than no time.

meaning_en: Just in time; at the last possible moment.
example_en: The rescue team arrived in the nick of time.
examples_extra: She arrived in the nick of time.
He was saved in the nick of time.

meaning_en: Beginning to appear or develop; in an early stage.
example_en: We caught the incipient problem before it escalated.
examples_extra: He felt an incipient cold coming on.
The plan is still incipient.

meaning_en: Impossible to stop or prevent; relentless.
example_en: The inexorable march of time affects us all.
examples_extra: Time moves with inexorable slowness.
The inexorable rise of prices worries everyone.

meaning_en: In a very short time; instantly.
meaning_fa: در یک چشم به هم زدن
example_en: I'll be ready to go in a jiffy.
examples_extra: I'll be ready (in a) jiffy.
Dinner will be ready (in a) jiffy.
note_fa: خیلی زود؛ در یک چشم به هم زدن.

meaning_en: Lasting for a long time or slow to disappear.
example_en: There was a lingering smell of smoke in the room.
examples_extra: A lingering smell of smoke filled the room.
He had a lingering doubt about the plan.

meaning_en: In a very short period of time.
example_en: I'll be with you in a mo, just finishing this email.
examples_extra: Just wait; I will be back (in a) mo.
The whole job was done (in a) mo.
note_fa: در یک لحظه؛ غیررسمی بریتانیایی: mo یعنی moment.

meaning_en: Very rarely; almost never.
meaning_fa: خیلی به ندرت، هر از گاهی
example_en: We only go out for dinner once in a blue moon.
examples_extra: We meet once in a blue moon.
He calls once in a blue moon.

meaning_en: Too old to be useful or effective.
example_en: He feels he's over the hill for competitive sports now.
examples_extra: He's over the hill now.
They're not over the hill.

meaning_en: Too old or no longer able to do something.
example_en: He thinks he's past it for playing professional football.
examples_extra: At 50, he felt past it.
The old car is past it now.

meaning_en: Continuing to do something despite difficulties or opposition.
example_en: Her persistent efforts eventually led to success.
examples_extra: She's very persistent and never gives up.
The persistent rain ruined our day.

meaning_en: To extend the duration of something.
example_en: The negotiations were prolonged for several weeks.
examples_extra: We should not prolong the meeting.
The drug may prolong his life.

meaning_en: Lasting for a long time, longer than expected.
example_en: The protracted negotiations finally reached a conclusion.
examples_extra: The talks were long and protracted.
After a protracted illness, he recovered.

meaning_en: happening many times, often
example_en: He repeatedly tried to contact her, but she didn't answer.
examples_extra: She knocked repeatedly and loudly.
He called her repeatedly yesterday.

meaning_en: In a very short moment; immediately. (Informal)
example_en: I'll be with you in a sec.
examples_extra: I will be with you in (in a) sec, just finishing this.
Hang on, I will fix it in (in a) sec.
note_fa: عامیانه: فوراً؛ in a mo هم همین معنی.

meaning_en: Happening or existing at the same time.
example_en: The two events were simultaneous.
examples_extra: The two attacks were simultaneous.
We heard simultaneous loud applause.

meaning_en: For a very long time; since the beginning.
example_en: They've known each other since the year dot.
examples_extra: They've lived here since the year dot.
I've known her since the year dot.

meaning_en: Very soon; in a moment.
example_en: I'll be with you in a tick, just finishing this email.
examples_extra: I'll be there in (in a) tick.
Wait (in a) tick, I'm coming!

meaning_en: For a very long time; indefinitely.
example_en: You can argue till the cows come home, but I won't change my mind.
examples_extra: You can wait till the cows come home.
He'll argue till the cows come home.

meaning_en: Lasting only for a short time; temporary.
example_en: The beauty of cherry blossoms is transient.
examples_extra: The effect was only transient, not permanent.
A transient population lives here in summer.
